content.short: Strike Finance is a Cardano derivatives protocol offering on-chain options, forwards, and perpetual futures trading.
content.description: Strike Finance is designed to bring crypto derivatives trading onto Cardano through products such as options, forwards, and perpetual futures. The project frames itself as a response to the lack of on-chain derivatives infrastructure in the Cardano ecosystem, where most crypto derivatives activity still happens on centralized exchanges. By offering these instruments directly on Cardano, Strike Finance aims to give traders a broader set of tools for managing risk, taking directional positions, and participating in more advanced markets on-chain.
content.meta: Find out about Strike Finance (STRIKE) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
